title: Inventory
description: The countable things you hand over — what is on the shelf, and what is about to run out.

stat.attentionNote: Out of stock or below the level you set
stat.attentionLine: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing needs attention} one {# item needs attention} other {# items need attention}}
stat.valueNote: What the shelves are worth at cost
stat.unsoldNote: Items no booking or event offers yet

toast.created: Item added. Receive stock to start its count.

empty.title: Nothing in inventory yet
empty.body: Add the things you hand over — a programme, a bottle of water, a set of bibs — and every booking and event can offer them.
empty.attentionBody: Every counted item is above the level you set for it.
empty.archivedBody: Items you archive are kept here, out of the way.
empty.noMatchBody: Try another word, or a different kind.

dialog.reasonHelp: The ledger is the only record of this. In six weeks it is the only thing that explains the number.

itemDescription: What it is, where it is, and everything that has happened to it.
newDescription: Something you hand over and want to count. How many you have comes next.
untrackedNote: This item is not counted, so it has no ledger. Turn counting on in Details if you want to track it.
ledgerNote: On hand is the sum of this. Nothing else keeps the count.
ledgerEmpty: Nothing yet. Receive stock to start the ledger.
soldWithHelp: Bookings and events that offer it as an extra. Add it from the booking or the event — the link lives with the thing that sells it, so it can never point at nothing.
soldWithEmpty: Nothing offers this yet, so it will sit on the shelf.

fact.valueNote: On hand at what you paid
fact.onLoanNote: Handed out and not back yet

form.name: Name
form.skuHelp: Optional. Whatever you already call it on paper.
form.priceHelp: Leave at 0 for something included rather than sold.
form.costHelp: Values the stock on hand. Nothing else uses it.
form.trackedHelp: On for anything physical. Off for a service — a count of somebody's minutes is a number nobody can correct.
form.returnableHelp: Hire shoes, audio guides, bibs. Returns show in the ledger and go back on the shelf.
form.lowAtHelp: Below this it appears under Needs attention. Ten tote bags is plenty; ten pairs of hire shoes is a Saturday.
form.whereHelp: A counter can only sell what is kept at its own venue.
